inputs.original_text:
They want us to believe this is just some routine legal slip-up, but look closer at the real coordination happening behind the scenes. According to the court documents, lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. And what was their excuse? They previously cited an agency memo from May of last year to justify the arrests, yet federal prosecutors now admit that this very memo gave no authorization for the arrests at all. 

Don't buy the official narrative that this was accidental incompetence. This was a calculated, systemic operation to target people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts. The revelation came to light in a lawsuit challenging this exact practice, exposing how the machinery of the state operates under a cover story while executing the hidden agenda of the elites.
inputs.modified_text:
They want us to swallow the lie that this is just a routine legal slip-up or accidental incompetence, but that is merely the cover story. Behind the scenes, the hidden elites and institutions coordinated a systemic operation. 

Look at what the court documents actually expose: lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. Their excuse was an agency memo from May of last year to justify the arrests, yet federal prosecutors now admit that this very memo gave no authorization for the arrests at all. 

This was never about mistakes. It was a calculated, systemic operation to target people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts, perfectly revealing how the machinery of the state operates under a false narrative while executing its true, concealed agenda.
